# seeded-random

`mulberry32(seed)` → a `() => number` in [0, 1) that yields the same sequence
for the same seed on every host. Generated art and generated worlds (Isle's
islands and buildings) are built from it, so they come out identical on every
run. Seed it from a string with `fnv1a32` (`packages/string-hash`).
